title: A tensor square theorem for characters of $\operatorname{GL}_{n}(q)$
summary: We construct an irreducible character of $\operatorname{GL}_{n}(q)$ whose square contains every irreducible character that is trivial on the centre of $\operatorname{GL}_{n}(q)$. This character is related to, but in general not equal to, the Steinberg character. A key ingredient, which we also prove, is that every nonlinear irreducible character of $\operatorname{GL}_{n}(q)$ that is trivial on the centre contains the trivial character when restricted to the diagonal subgroup $T$.
